limitations: Automated source curation and independent automated cross-review are not qualified human review or experimental replication.
Direct and proxy labels apply only to the declared endpoint; no general clinical or experiment-selection benefit is implied.
Incomplete controls, inaccessible source tables, conflicting denominators and unresolved independence remain explicit.
Historical mappings, result values and archived source bytes are unchanged.

The five new 2026-10-05 mappings are each a narrow proxy for one declared endpoint: paired criteria-version reclassification is not accuracy or review time (Benet-Pages t2/t3); tool-vs-tool agreement on conflicting variants is not accuracy against ground truth (So 2024); agreement with ClinGen eRepo submissions from an unreviewed, not-peer-reviewed preprint is not independent accuracy (HECTOR); and BRCA2 exon 15-26 functional-data classification yield is not a complete professional classification review (Hu 2026). None implies qualified human scientific review or Rewire model execution.

2026-10-06 correction: the HECTOR mapping's comparator had been mislabelled as "ClinVar expert-panel" in several places across the 2026-10-05 coverage package and this inputs.json; re-verified live against the preprint and relabelled as the ENIGMA VCEP's expert-curated classifications and evidence-code assignments in the ClinGen Evidence Repository (eRepo). The mapping's evidence_sha256 was refreshed to match; the other four 2026-10-05 mappings and all prior mappings are unchanged. The 108/143 and 326/413 figures are unchanged.

The two new 2026-10-06 cell-type-annotation-transfer mappings are each a single donor-held-out ROC-AUC within one pooled 249-dataset corpus, not a whole-study or whole-platform holdout and not a rejection-at-coverage curve or demonstrated calibration. They measure two distinct endpoints (unknown/absent-type detection vs. known-type error detection) from the same uncertainty mechanism and must never be combined, averaged, or described interchangeably. use-case-cell-type-annotation-transfer remains an incomplete, open evidence-collection case; its collection_plan.status and evidence_gaps are unchanged by this addition.

Same day, both 2026-10-06 scTab cell-type-annotation-transfer mappings' evidence_sha256 were refreshed after an independent review found the underlying catalogue records described the uncertainty mechanism imprecisely (averaging order, an unsupported 'temperature-scaled' claim, n_runs vs. ensemble_size, and an unsupported 'data augmentation enabled' assertion); see data/omics/use-case-coverage-20261006/research/research.md's 'Correction, same day' note. No ROC-AUC value or endpoint scoping changed.

The third 2026-10-06 cell-type-annotation-transfer mapping (Abdelaal et al. 2019) is INTRA-dataset only (same single Baron Human dataset, stratified 5-fold cross-validation); it does not establish cross-study or cross-platform transfer. The source's own genuine inter-dataset/cross-platform experiments (Fig. 4, Fig. 5) are not ingested. scArches's ~84% accuracy figure remains unresolved and is not promoted to any record: the accuracy-formula denominator (all-cell vs. accepted-only) is not stated for the figure that reports it (Fig. 4c); the only explicit formula found in the accessible text applies to a different, narrower-population figure (Supplementary Fig. 17, which explicitly excludes the unseen tissue).

Same day, the Abdelaal mapping's evidence_sha256 was refreshed again after a further independent review: its source's retrieved_at is now the real re-fetch timestamp 2026-10-06T23:28:54Z UTC (byte-identical to the earlier cached copy; a bounded-window estimate had been used, which the original research dossier explicitly did not support as a per-file timestamp), the retrieved bytes are archived as a committed gzip artifact under data/omics/use-case-coverage-20261006/research/artifacts/ (not only the gitignored workbench copy), the three unlabeled-percentage results now carry metric_direction: "unknown" instead of "lower" (percentage unlabeled is a coverage/rejection-rate tradeoff against the same classifier's own median F1, not a metric with one universal direction; "unknown" is the schema's own third value, not an invented one), and the 8,569-cell Table 2 figure is now explicitly described as the dataset size, not a confirmed per-classifier scored denominator. No printed value changed; all prior mappings, the two scTab mappings, and the existing active mapping remain byte-identical.
